description: This PHP class, NationalityService, provides service-layer operations related to managing nationality entities in the OrangeHRM system, including fetching, saving, deleting, and normalizing nationality data, often interacting with a DAO layer.

classes.name: NationalityService
classes.description: Service class handling operations related to Nationality entities, including CRUD, existence check, listing, and normalization.

methods.name: getNationalityDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the NationalityDao instance used for database interactions.

methods.name: setNationalityDao
methods.description: Sets the NationalityDao instance, allowing for dependency injection.

methods.name: getNationalityList
methods.description: Fetches a list of nationalities based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getNationalityCount
methods.description: Returns the count of nationalities matching the search criteria.

methods.name: saveNationality
methods.description: Saves a Nationality entity to the database.

methods.name: getNationalityById
methods.description: Retrieves a Nationality by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getNationalityByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Nationality entity based on its name.

methods.name: deleteNationalities
methods.description: Deletes multiple nationalities identified by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingNationalityName
methods.description: Checks whether a nationality name already exists in the system.

methods.name: getNationalityArray
methods.description: Retrieves all nationalities and normalizes them into an array of NationalityModel for external use.
